scientific_integrity: Full-state Bell reset with age-dependent hazard is defined operationally; exact formula is proved by finite renewal identities, the Legendre generating function and standard root/asymptotic theorems. Finite code checks support but do not certify infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric inverse-linear age hazard, global Bell reset, local phase gate and classical-unobserved trajectories are covered. Prior mathematical identities are classical; a previously unlocated equivalent physical theorem remains possible.
title: Exact Legendre entanglement nodes and Bessel scaling under a critical discrete reset clock
